name: Home
purpose: Primary entry point. Routes visitors into departments and campaigns, and demonstrates visitor-type hero personalization, affinity-based CTAs and campaign banners.
personalizationRules: home-hero: logged-in users see the member hero; else returning visitors see "Welcome back"; everyone else (new visitors) sees the first-order WELCOME15 hero.
home-cart-reminder: only cart abandoners see the "You left something in your cart" banner with SAVE10.
home-promo: 50/50 A/B split of two flash-sale banner treatments (sticky per visitor).
home-cta: electronics shoppers get an electronics CTA, fashion shoppers a fashion CTA, everyone else the Rewards CTA.
successMetrics: Banner CTR (A vs B) and lift

name: Shop
purpose: Department hub that funnels traffic into category pages and collections; demonstrates search tracking and an affinity-based featured department.
personalizationRules: shop-featured: electronics shoppers see the electronics feature, fashion shoppers the fashion feature, everyone else a home appliances feature.
successMetrics: Search usage rate and zero-result rate

name: Electronics
purpose: Category landing for Electronics. Demonstrates category views, filter/sort usage, in-grid search, product clicks, location-based promotions and audience-specific offers.
personalizationRules: electronics-geo-promo: visitor location (time zone proxy for Target geo attributes) selects the US West, US East or Europe promotion, otherwise the default.
electronics-offer: first matching audience wins in this order: high-value-customers > logged-in-users > new-visitors > default.
successMetrics: Category view to product click rate
Filter usage rate and most used filters
Add to cart rate from grid

name: Fashion
purpose: Category landing for Fashion. Demonstrates category views, filter/sort usage, in-grid search, product clicks, location-based promotions and audience-specific offers.
personalizationRules: fashion-geo-promo: visitor location (time zone proxy for Target geo attributes) selects the US West, US East or Europe promotion, otherwise the default.
fashion-offer: first matching audience wins in this order: fashion-shoppers > logged-in-users > new-visitors > default.
successMetrics: Category view to product click rate
Filter usage rate and most used filters
Add to cart rate from grid

name: Home Appliances
purpose: Category landing for Home Appliances. Demonstrates category views, filter/sort usage, in-grid search, product clicks, location-based promotions and audience-specific offers.
personalizationRules: home-appliances-geo-promo: visitor location (time zone proxy for Target geo attributes) selects the US West, US East or Europe promotion, otherwise the default.
home-appliances-offer: first matching audience wins in this order: high-value-customers > frequent-buyers > default.
successMetrics: Category view to product click rate
Filter usage rate and most used filters
Add to cart rate from grid

name: Product Listing
purpose: Search results and full catalogue listing. Receives header/search block queries (?q=) and demonstrates search, filter, sort and product impression tracking.
personalizationRules: plp-offer: cart abandoners see a "finish your order" banner, new visitors the WELCOME15 banner, everyone else a free shipping message.

name: Product Details
purpose: Product detail page (PDP). Demonstrates product views, image gallery usage, tab clicks, add to cart, wishlist adds, review clicks and Target Recommendations (similar, cross-sell, recently viewed).
personalizationRules: pdp-recommendations: Target Recommendations "people who viewed this also viewed" (entity.id = productId); simulator shows same-category products.
pdp-cross-sell: "frequently bought together" accessories for the category.
pdp-recently-viewed: products from the visitor profile (hidden on first product view).
pdp-trust: A/B test of free-returns messaging vs. rating social proof.
successMetrics: Product view -> add to cart rate

name: Best Sellers
purpose: Merchandising collection driven by social proof. Shows frequent buyers a loyalty perk.
personalizationRules: bestsellers-offer: frequent buyers (3+ orders) get free express shipping; everyone else sees review highlights.
successMetrics: Perk banner CTR for frequent buyers

name: New Arrivals
purpose: Freshness-driven collection. Features a new product matched to the visitor's category affinity.
personalizationRules: new-arrivals-feature: electronics shoppers see the Lumen Book laptop, fashion shoppers the Riviera dress, others the Barista Touch espresso machine.

name: Deals
purpose: Promotional hub and the multivariate test page: two headlines x two banners are combined independently (full factorial MVT).
personalizationRules: MVT-DEALS: deals-headline (A/B) and deals-banner (A/B) are assigned independently per visitor, producing 4 combinations; Target MVT reports element contribution.

name: Seasonal Offers
purpose: Seasonal campaign landing with location-aware hero and a collection carousel.
personalizationRules: seasonal-hero: European visitors see the "Autumn in Europe" hero (EU shipping), US West visitors a mild-weather edit, others the default fall hero.

name: Wishlist
purpose: Saved products. Demonstrates wishlist views/removals, move to cart and a sign-in prompt for anonymous users.
personalizationRules: wishlist-offer: logged-in users see price-drop alert messaging; anonymous users are prompted to sign in to sync their wishlist.

name: Cart
purpose: Cart review. Demonstrates cart views, quantity changes, removals, coupon usage, a high cart value discount banner and a personalized coupon.
personalizationRules: cart-offer: cart subtotal >= $300 (high-cart-value condition) unlocks the VIP20 banner, otherwise an incentive to reach $300 is shown. Evaluated on page load.
cart-coupon: cart abandoners get SAVE10, new visitors WELCOME15; others see no coupon (no default experience).
successMetrics: AOV for high cart value audience

name: Checkout
purpose: Single-page checkout. Demonstrates checkout start, step tracking, shipping and payment selection and checkout completion (purchase).
personalizationRules: checkout-trust: A/B test of security badges (A) vs. social proof (B) above the form.

name: Order Confirmation
purpose: Post-purchase page. Shows the order summary and a next-best-action (membership upsell for first-time buyers).
personalizationRules: confirmation-next: first-time buyers are invited to join Rewards, frequent buyers get a VIP thank-you, everyone else continues shopping.

name: My Account
purpose: Account dashboard. Demo sign-in/sign-out switches the authState used by Logged-In Users and Anonymous Users audiences.
personalizationRules: account-hero: logged-in users see their dashboard; anonymous users see the sign-in prompt with member benefits.

name: Order History
purpose: Order history for signed-in customers (sample orders are seeded on sign-in).
personalizationRules: orders-reorder: frequent buyers see a "buy it again" carousel, everyone else a Rewards reminder.

name: Track Orders
purpose: Self-service order tracking by order number. Demonstrates form-based events with success/failure attributes.
personalizationRules: tracking-help: logged-in users are pointed to their order list; anonymous users are told where to find the order number.

name: Customer Support
purpose: Help centre. Demonstrates on-page content search, FAQ engagement and priority support messaging for high-value customers.
personalizationRules: support-priority: high-value customers see the priority phone line; logged-in users live chat; everyone else self-service links.

name: Contact Us
purpose: Contact channels with tracked channel CTAs; cart abandoners get cart-specific help.
personalizationRules: contact-cta: cart abandoners are offered help completing their order; others see general support hours.

name: About Us
purpose: Brand story page with an A/B test on the closing CTA copy.
personalizationRules: about-cta: A/B test, "Explore NovaMart" (A) vs "Start shopping" (B).

name: Blog Landing
purpose: Content hub that drives article views; blog readers (2+ articles) are invited to the newsletter.
personalizationRules: blog-newsletter: blog readers see a newsletter sign-up CTA; others see the most popular guide.
successMetrics: Newsletter CTA CTR for blog readers

name: Blog Details
purpose: Article detail. Demonstrates article views, reading time milestones, CTA interactions and an A/B test on the article CTA; reading 2+ articles qualifies the Blog Readers audience.
personalizationRules: blog-cta: A/B test, product CTA (A) vs comparison CTA (B).

name: Store Locator
purpose: Store finder. Demonstrates store search (searchType=store), directions clicks and location-based promotions.
personalizationRules: stores-promo: visitors are shown the event at their nearest region (US West, US East, Europe) or a generic in-store pickup message.

name: Membership Program
purpose: Loyalty programme page. Demonstrates premium user messaging for members and an enrollment banner for new users; #aep:enroll records membershipEnroll.
personalizationRules: membership-hero: premium members (gold/platinum) see their benefits hero; everyone else the join hero.
membership-enroll: new visitors see the 500 bonus points enrollment banner; returning non-members a "join today" banner; members see nothing.

name: FAQ
purpose: Searchable FAQ with FAQPage structured data, question toggles and helpfulness feedback.
personalizationRules: faq-help: cart abandoners get a "need help finishing your order?" CTA; others the general help CTA.

name: Privacy Policy
purpose: Legal content. Also documents (for trainees) which analytics and personalization data the training site collects.
personalizationRules: privacy-preferences: logged-in users are pointed to the preference centre; others to the privacy team.

name: Terms and Conditions
purpose: Legal content page; mirrors the privacy page personalization to show XT reuse across pages.
personalizationRules: terms-preferences: same XT-LEGAL activity as the privacy page, separate location.

name: Personalized Recommendations
purpose: Recommendations showcase: user-affinity recommendations, category affinity XT and recently viewed items in one page.
personalizationRules: recs-top-picks: Target Recommendations with "user favourite category" criteria (simulator: best sellers).
recs-affinity: electronics or fashion shoppers see a grid of their top category; others a home appliances grid.
recs-recently-viewed: profile based, hidden until the visitor has viewed a product.
successMetrics: Affinity grid add to cart rate

name: 404 Page
purpose: Error recovery page. Tracks errorPageView with the requested URL and recovers visitors with search and affinity-based recommendations.
personalizationRules: error-recovery: electronics or fashion shoppers see products from their category; others see best sellers.
successMetrics: Recovery rate (search or product click after 404)
